cmd:
cat > /tmp/start_run.py <<EOF
import json, urllib.request
cfg = dict(tf="15m", entry_mode="stages", entry_trigger="breakout", stop_mode="sig3", tp_r=3.0, max_bars=96, rev_exit=False,
           be_trigger=30.0, be_lock=0.0, trail_mode="none", pat_mode="off", pat_filter="none", fee=0.09,
           stages=[{"t": "pattern", "p": 0, "w": 0, "f": "none"}, {"t": "ema50_trend", "p": 0, "w": 1, "f": "none"},
                   {"t": "ema50_pullback", "p": 0, "w": 1, "f": "none"}, {"t": "stochrsi_cross", "p": 0, "w": 1, "f": "none"}])
body = json.dumps({"action": "start", "sym": "ZECUSDT", "name": "EMA50 + Stoch RSI, пробой, цель 3R, 24 ч", "config": cfg}).encode()
r = urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("http://127.0.0.1:8091/api/runs", body, {"Content-Type": "application/json"}), timeout=60)
d = json.load(r)
for x in d["runs"]: print(x["id"], x["name"], x["sym"], x["stats"], "стадии:", [s["t"] for s in x["cfg"]["stages"]], x["cfg"].get("entry_trigger"), x["cfg"].get("stop_mode"), x["cfg"].get("tp_r"))
EOF
/opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python /tmp/start_run.py 2>&1 | tail -n 8
systemctl is-active classicbot
